home_text: No CAD? Take a photo of your paper pattern pieces with your phone. BETA finds the shapes and plans the marker.
title: Photo to marker
lead: Take a photo of your paper pattern pieces. BETA finds the shapes. You check them. Then BETA plans the marker.
practice_note: Practice mode: these pieces and results are samples. Do not cut fabric from them.
guide_title: How to take a good photo
guide_1: Dark cloth or floor under the pieces
guide_2: A plain A4 sheet next to the pieces
mode_quick_hint: Use a full A4 sheet. Compare a long distance on the paper before cutting.
mode_accurate_hint: Print the BETA target at actual size (A3). Check its scale and compare a paper measurement.
engine_missing: Photo reading is not in this version yet. You can try the steps with a sample photo.
photos_empty: No photo yet. Lay all pieces flat and take a photo.
photo_tip: Many pieces? Take more photos. Keep the A4 sheet in every photo.
w_blur_fix: Hold the phone still. Tap the screen to focus.
w_tilt_fix: Hold the phone flat, straight above the pieces.
w_glare_fix: Move away from the tube light or turn the phone a little.
w_shadow_fix: Stand so your shadow does not fall on the pieces.
w_low_contrast_fix: Use a dark cloth under light paper. Move to more light.
w_piece_outside_photo: A piece is cut off at the edge
w_piece_outside_photo_fix: Step back so all pieces are inside the photo.
w_scale_low_confidence_fix: Keep the whole A4 sheet flat and in view. Check one piece with a tape.
w_reference_ambiguous: A4 sheet not found for sure
w_reference_ambiguous_fix: Use one plain white A4 sheet. Keep it away from white pattern paper.
w_second_sheet_mismatch: The two A4 sheets do not agree
w_second_sheet_mismatch_fix: Keep both sheets flat on the same floor. Hold the phone flat.
w_touching_pieces_fix: Leave a gap of two fingers between pieces.
w_grain_unconfirmed_fix: Check the grain arrow on this piece.
w_duplicate_piece_fix: Remove one copy when you check the pieces.
w_review_required_fix: Look at the outline and fix it if needed.
w_piece_limit: Too many pieces in one photo
w_piece_limit_fix: Take two photos with fewer pieces.
w_other_fix: Check the photo and try again.
review_hint: Tap a piece to check it. Only pieces you accept are used.
outline_note: Lines show what BETA found. If a line is wrong, delete the piece and take a clearer photo.
chip_duplicate: Same as a piece in another photo: remove this copy?
name: Name
pair_hint: One left and one right (mirrored) piece.
fold_hint: Fabric is folded on the centre line. BETA cuts one full piece.
fold_none: This piece is not symmetric, so it cannot be cut on fold.
grain_hint: The arrow must run along the fabric length.
use_piece_grain: Use piece and grain as shown
accept_all_hint: This also confirms the grain arrow shown on each piece.
width_too_small: Width is too small. Check the unit (inch or cm).
width_too_large: Width is too large. Check the unit (inch or cm).
layout_folded_hint: Folded in half along the length
nap_hint: Velvet, pile or a one-way print. Pieces are not turned upside down.
garments_hint: Garments of each size in this marker.
nest_none_yet: First result in a few seconds…
nest_no_engine: The browser nester could not load. Reload BETA while connected, or use the BETA desktop app or shop server.
usual_hint: Optional. Enter what you use today to see the saving.
saved_none: No saving against your usual length. Keep your usual way, or try Best time.
practice_result: Practice layout. Not a real marker.
print_tiles_hint: Print at 100% (actual size). Tape pages together using the crosses.
chalk_hint: Where to place each piece, measured from the start and the selvedge.
projector_hint: Show the marker 1:1 on the table with a projector.
share_hint: Send to the plotter shop, for example by WhatsApp.
target_needs_app: The A3 target sheet is made by the board-photo digitizer, which is not in this browser edition. Print it from the BETA desktop app or a shop server, or use the A4 sheet mode.
start_again_confirm: Start again? Photos and pieces from this marker are removed.
proj_cal_text: Measure the square on the table with a tape. Enter what you measure.
proj_cal_done: Size corrected. Measure again to check: the square must be 100 mm.
proj_cal_bad: Enter both sizes in mm, for example 100.
proj_square: This square must be 100 mm × 100 mm on the table
proj_not_calibrated: Not calibrated yet. Sizes are only a guess.
install_hint: Add BETA to your phone. It works without internet after the first visit.
blocked_reading: Wait: the photo is still being read.
blocked_pending: Check every piece first: use it or delete it.
photo_every_size: One photo is one size. Take a photo of the pieces of every size you will cut: this flow does not grade sizes (use Make a style for grading).
blocked_tape_check: Compare a paper measurement for each photo used in this marker.
blocked_fabric_details: Correct the fabric GSM and gaps first.
set_hint: Saves the outlines and fabric settings as a file on this device. Photos are not in the file.
inv_title: Parts in this set, by fabric and size
inv_hint: Keep one garment style per set. Compare this list with your paper pieces: the app cannot know if a collar, facing or other part is missing.
fabric_group_hint: Parts in different fabrics get separate markers. If the same paper shape is also cut in lining or fusing, photograph a second copy for that fabric.
tape_title: Check the size against the paper
tape_step1: Tap two clear points on the outline, far apart (or type their numbers).
tape_step2: Measure the straight distance between the same points on the paper. Do not bend the tape.
tape_step3: Type it below and choose Compare with paper.
tape_svg: Pattern outline with numbered points. Choose two points for the tape check.
tape_bad: Does not match the paper. Retake the photo with the whole A4 sheet flat beside the pieces.
tape_note: Check one part from each photo you use in the marker. One distance does not check every curve, notch, seam allowance or the fit.
tape_practice: The tape check works on photos of your own paper pieces. The sample pieces have no paper to measure.
tape_choose: Choose two points on the outline first.
grain_title: Set the grain from the paper
grain_points_hint: Choose A and B along the grain arrow printed on the paper. Use this only if the suggested grain is wrong. The outline does not change.
fabric_only: Only {group} parts are in this marker. Make a separate marker for each fabric group.
gsm_placeholder: From the supplier or your test
gsm_hint: Kept with the marker for costing. It does not change the pattern size, stretch or shrinkage.
fabric_invalid: Enter a valid GSM and gaps before making the marker.
unchecked_title: Check the size on paper first
unchecked_text: Open one piece from each of these photos and choose Compare with paper: {photos}.
photo_review_guidance: Review the outlines and confirm the grain arrows. Check one distance with a tape before cutting.
sample_start_again: Save your pattern set and start again before opening the sample.
sample_tape_hint: Synthetic teaching set at 30% scale: the long straight side edge on either body panel is 14.39 cm. Use this known fixture distance for the sample check. Measure your own paper with a tape.
